summary.visualReviewTriageThresholdRationale: This is a deterministic review-prioritization cutoff over the triage score (normalized sample, luma, non-background, and logical-size deltas); it is not a pass/fail or visual-parity acceptance threshold. Rows at or above it remain unresolved review candidates until a human compares the paired evidence.
